exposure: laterality of initial screening failure (bilateral vs unilateral)
cohort: 6817 low-risk, term and late-preterm newborns from a large, urban, academic medical center over a one-year period.
finding: Delaying AABR screening in the first 48 hours minimized failure rates, although SNHL was six times more likely in infants who failed their final screening at >=48 hours compared to those screened earlier.
